1358ztp0j1b.message: I hash each string into an ID and write a brief: the text, where it's used, the plural forms the language needs. The agent needs no repo access.

13utvpasyhq.message: Squint at an empty call, __(''), and it's a duck face.

1jsislrimyd.message: Then I check everything: unknown IDs, empty strings, malformed plurals, invented placeholders. One error and the whole file bounces. Nothing is written.

20uz4bydvld.message: The last line was added after the brief. It is not in es.json yet, so it renders in English.

223uh4d0ifb.message: Any agent translates the brief. I never call a model. Judgment is its job.

23rimor1ove.message: You write English inline, right where it renders. Nothing else in your code changes.

280oewmzbwo.message: Anything not translated yet falls back to your English, so a partial catalog still ships.

5uesicm2of.message: This page is translated with duckalization.

fw6e55g8wg.message: Write English. An agent translates. The duck checks.

h1dp81alo9.message: Its Spanish catalog is deliberately incomplete. Switch to Español and turn on Show fallbacks to see which strings are still in English.

qvnu5kpdmn.message: It does the judgment. I do the checking.

yj9vauciil.message: No translation keys: every message’s ID is hashed from its own text. The CLI extracts your strings, hands any agent a brief, and checks every translation before it lands.
